description: This file defines an Akka actor class 'QueryThingsPerRequestActor' responsible for handling 'QueryThings' commands in a gateway service. It manages the process of querying for things based on search results, retrieving detailed information, and responding with combined results. It also notifies about out-of-sync entities. The class encapsulates the actor lifecycle, message handling, and interaction with other components, such as proxy actors and pub/sub mediators.

classes.name: QueryThingsPerRequestActor
classes.description: An Akka actor responsible for handling 'QueryThings' requests in the gateway, retrieving detailed thing information, and managing out-of-sync notifications.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration for instantiating the actor with necessary parameters.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior for the actor, including timeouts, responses, and other message types.

methods.name: getSelectedFieldsWithThingId
methods.description: Determines the fields to retrieve, ensuring the Thing ID field is included.

methods.name: getEntitiesWithSelectedFields
methods.description: Maps retrieved entities to include only the originally selected fields.

methods.name: notifyOutOfSyncThings
methods.description: Publishes out-of-sync notifications for entities not present in the retrieved results.
